documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Ram Ratna Wires Limited reported robust financial and operational metrics in its October 2026 investor presentation, highlighting growth across both its winding-wire and copper-tube segments. Management detailed expanding manufacturing footprints, integration of subsidiaries like EPAVO Electricals, and structural demand drivers across electrification, power infrastructure, and electric vehicles. The company also outlined capacity scale-ups at Tefabo and a strong multi-year track record in revenue and profitability. Ram Ratna Wires Limited reported its financial and operational performance for Q1 FY27, highlighting significant revenue growth and strategic expansions in its product portfolio including copper tubes and pipes. Management noted increased capacity utilization, ongoing capex for new lines, and contributions from joint ventures and subsidiaries like Epavo Electricals and Tefabo Product.

demand_outlook.claim: India's room AC units sold reached 11 to 11.5 million in FY26.
demand_outlook.quote: 11 - 11.5 Mn room AC units sold in India, FY26

capex_expansion.claim: Production successfully commenced at the Bhiwadi Unit.
capex_expansion.quote: Production Successfully Commenced at Bhiwadi Unit

capex_expansion.claim: Tefabo Product Pvt. Ltd. is undertaking a phased capacity expansion in Vadodara, increasing capacity from approximately 40 towers per month to 80 towers per month.
capex_expansion.quote: Vadodara, Gujarat — undertaking a phased capacity expansion, increasing capacity from ~40 towers/month to ~80 towers/month

capex_expansion.claim: Expansion is planned in two phases with Phase 1 to deliver 20 towers per month and Phase 2 to add another 20 towers per month upon achieving Phase 1 scale.
capex_expansion.quote: Expansion planned in two phases; Phase 1 to deliver 20 towers/month, Phase 2 to add another 20 towers/month upon achieving Phase 1 scale

margins_costs.claim: Copper tubes and pipes share improved significantly from 14% to 22%, reflecting strategic diversification and positioning the portfolio for long-term growth and profitability.
margins_costs.quote: Copper Tubes & Pipes share improved significantly from 14% to 22% reflecting strategic diversification, positioning the portfolio for long-term growth and profitability.

margins_costs.claim: Exceptional item of INR 3.6 crore pertains to provisions and adjustments related to the implementation of new labor codes.
margins_costs.quote: *Exceptional item of INR 3.6 crore pertains to provisions/adjustments related to implementation of new labor codes

orders_capacity.claim: EPAVO Electricals has 3 million motors per annum installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: 30 lakh motors/annum installed; >90% localisation in HVLS PMSM motors.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed capacity at the Baroda plant is 12,000 MTPA for copper tubes and pipes.
orders_capacity.quote: Baroda, Gujarat Installed Capacity: 12,000 MTPA Product capabilities: Copper Tubes & Pipes

orders_capacity.claim: Tefabo Product Pvt Ltd holds 30 to 40 percent of the market in key product segments for wind turbine tower internals.
orders_capacity.quote: Market Position: Holds 30–40% of the market in key product segments

capital_allocation.claim: Bonus equity shares were issued in a 1:1 ratio.

management_commitments.claim: RRWL plans to acquire EPACK's 50% stake in EPAVO for Rs 15 Cr with expected closing on November 30, 2026.
management_commitments.quote: RRWL to acquire EPACK’s 50% stake for ₹15 Cr

management_commitments.claim: Demo small wind turbine is to be installed at Chikmagalur in Q1, with European tech transfer agreement in progress.
management_commitments.quote: ❑ Demo small wind turbine to be installed at Chikmagalur in Q1; European tech transfer agreement in progress
